title: In JetBrains Junie CLI before 26.6.29 sensitive environment variables were exposed in session event logs…
description: JetBrains Junie CLI versions prior to 26.6.29 exposed sensitive environment variables in session event logs. This exposure could allow local users with limited privileges to access confidential information stored in environment variables. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.5.
